tips.label: will 後接原形
tips.text: will／won't + 原形動詞；若後面是形容詞或名詞，用 will be。

tips.label: be going to 要配主詞
tips.text: I am；he／she／it is；you／we／they are。going to 後面接原形動詞，簡答保留 be。

tips.label: 未來式的兩個提醒
tips.text: 「將會有」用 There will be；when、before、after 表未來時間時，子句用現在式。

tips.label: 先看誰花費、花什麼
tips.text: 人花時間或錢用 spend；人付款用 pay；物品花多少錢用 cost；事情花多少時間用 take。

tips.label: 動作接法
tips.text: spend + 時間／金錢 + V-ing；It takes + 人 + 時間 + to V；It costs + 人 + 金錢 + to V。

tips.label: 問金錢、問多久
tips.text: How much 問金額；How long 問時間長度。do／does／did／will 後面的動詞都用原形。

notes.title: will：肯定、否定與 be
notes.rule: 主詞 + will／will not（won't）+ 原形動詞；主詞 + will be + 名詞／形容詞
notes.description: will 不隨主詞的人稱或單複數改變。一般動詞直接用原形；若描述身分或狀態，仍須補上 be。不能寫 will goes、will is 或 will happy。will 的否定是 will not，可縮寫為 won't。字詞表的 would 是 will 的過去式，本課先練習 will 的未來表達。
examples: We will visit the temple tomorrow.
She won't sell her boat.
The trip will be wonderful.

notes.title: will：問句、簡答與省略句
notes.rule: Will + 主詞 + 原形動詞？／Wh- + will + 主詞 + 原形動詞？
notes.description: 問句將 will 放到主詞前；不另加 do／does。肯定簡答用 Yes, 主詞 + will.；否定簡答用 No, 主詞 + won't.。簡答末尾的肯定 will 不縮成 I'll。避免重複動作時，可保留 will 代替前面提過的內容。
examples: Will you pay in cash? Yes, I will.
Will he visit the bank? No, he won't.
Dad will take a trip, and Mom will, too.

notes.title: be going to：未來計畫
notes.rule: 主詞 + am／is／are +（not）going to + 原形動詞
notes.description: I 用 am；he、she、it 及單數名詞用 is；you、we、they 及複數名詞用 are。否定在 be 後加 not，問句將 be 移到主詞前。簡答保留 be，不改成 will 或 do。省略重複內容時，be 也要跟著新的主詞變化。
examples: They are going to try local food.
Is she going to stay here? No, she isn't.
Ben is going to buy flowers, and I am, too.

notes.title: 未來問句的疑問詞
notes.rule: Where 問地點；When 問時間；Who 問人物；How 問方式；How long 問多久
notes.description: 先看回答提供哪一類資訊，再選疑問詞。How long 對應持續時間，例如 for three nights；When 對應出發或開始的時間，例如 tomorrow morning。How much 則對應金額。
examples: Where will you stay? At a hotel.
How are you going to get there? By bus.
How long will you stay? For three nights.

notes.title: 未來時間詞與 will／be going to
notes.rule: tomorrow；next + 時間；in + 一段時間；tonight；soon
notes.description: in an hour 用於這類未來語境時表示一小時後。this morning 等時間詞不一定表示未來，須依事件發生時間判斷。will 常表當下決定、承諾或預測；be going to 常表事先計畫或有跡象的預測。兩者在許多情況下都合理，不能只看到 tomorrow 就認定只能使用其中一種。
examples: I will call you in an hour.
We are going to leave next Monday.
The bag looks useful. I'll buy it.

notes.title: 現在進行式也能表已安排的未來
notes.rule: 主詞 + am／is／are + V-ing + 未來時間
notes.description: go、come、leave、stay、arrive 等動詞，可用現在進行式描述已安排的未來活動。句型仍需完整的 be + V-ing。be going to + 地點中的 going 是「去」；be going to + 原形動詞則是未來句型，要看 to 後面接的是地點還是動作。
examples: Our tickets are booked. We are leaving tomorrow.
My daughter is coming back next week.
We are going to the bank this afternoon.

notes.title: 存在句的未來式
notes.rule: There will be + 名詞；There is／are going to be + 名詞
notes.description: 表達「將會有」時，保留 there be 的 be，不改用 have。使用 will 時，後面固定是 be；使用 be going to 時，第一個 be 依後方名詞單複數選 is 或 are，最後的 be 仍是原形。
examples: There will be a new bridge here.
There is going to be a bakery near the bank.
There are going to be two hotels in town.

notes.title: when、before、after 的未來時間子句
notes.rule: 主句用未來式；when／before／after + 主詞 + 現在式動詞
notes.description: 當這些連接詞引導未來時間副詞子句時，用現在式表達未來，不在子句中加 will。主詞是第三人稱單數時，動詞仍要加 s。這個規則針對時間子句；When will you leave? 是直接問句，仍可用 will。
examples: I will call you when I arrive.
We will eat before the tour starts.
After he gets home, he will count the money.

notes.title: cost：物品或事情花費金錢
notes.rule: 物 + cost(s) +（人）+ 金錢；It costs／cost +（人）+ 金錢 + to V
notes.description: 談價錢時，以物品作主詞，或用 It costs ... to V 表達做一件事的費用。現在式單數用 costs、複數用 cost；過去式仍是 cost，不是 costed。金額前面的人可以省略；若用代名詞則用 me、him、us 等受格。
examples: This fan costs two hundred dollars.
These flowers cost fifty dollars.
It cost us a thousand dollars to fix the boat.

notes.title: spend：人花時間或金錢
notes.rule: 人 + spend(s)／spent + 時間／金錢 + V-ing；人 + spend(s)／spent + 時間／金錢 + on + 名詞
notes.description: spend 的主詞是人。後面接動作時用 V-ing；接事物時可用 on + 名詞。不要套用 take 的 to V。過去式是 spent；現在式的第三人稱單數用 spends。
examples: I spent an hour choosing a gift.
She spends a hundred dollars on lunch every day.
We spent five hundred dollars buying local food.

notes.title: pay：人付款
notes.rule: 人 + pay(s)／paid + 金錢 + for + 物；人 + pay(s)／paid + 帳單
notes.description: pay 的主詞是付款的人；過去式是 paid。買某物花多少錢，用 pay + 金額 + for + 物。也可省略金額說 pay for the meal；繳帳單可直接說 pay the bill。pay in cash 表示用現金付款。
examples: She paid three hundred dollars for the fan.
I will pay for the meal.
He pays the phone bill every month.

notes.title: take：事情花費時間
notes.rule: It takes／took +（人）+ 時間 + to V；事情／V-ing + takes／took +（人）+ 時間
notes.description: take 在本課表示花費時間。It 句型的動作接 to V；也可將動名詞片語放在句首，整件事視為單數。過去式是 took。表示花時間的人放在 take 後，代名詞用受格。
examples: It takes us ten minutes to walk there.
Cleaning the stall takes him half an hour.
The tour took three hours.

notes.title: How much、How long 與助動詞
notes.rule: How much + do／does／did + 人 + pay／spend…？；How much + do／does／did + 物 + cost？；How long + does／did + it + take…？
notes.description: 問金額用 How much，問時間長度用 How long。問句的助動詞依主詞與時態選擇；有 do、does、did 或 will，後面的主要動詞就用原形。常見錯誤包括 did paid、does costs、did took。
examples: How much did you pay for the flowers?
How much do these bags cost?
How long does it take to reach the church?

notes.title: 花費句型的同義轉換
notes.rule: 人 + spend + 時間 + V-ing ↔ It takes + 人 + 時間 + to V；物 cost 金額 ↔ 人 spend 金額 on 物 ↔ 人 pay 金額 for 物
notes.description: 轉換時先確認花的是時間還是金錢，再調整主詞與後面動作的形式。做事的人、金額或時間、時態都要保持相同。spend 接 V-ing；It takes／costs 接 to V；pay 常搭配 for + 物。
examples: We spent twenty minutes walking home. = It took us twenty minutes to walk home.
The fan cost me three hundred dollars. = I spent three hundred dollars on the fan.
I spent three hundred dollars on the fan. = I paid three hundred dollars for the fan.

quiz.question: Our class will ___ the temple next Friday.
quiz.hint: will 是助動詞，後面用原形動詞 visit；即使主詞是單數，也不加 s。

quiz.question: Don't wait for Ben at the bakery. He won't ___ here tomorrow.
quiz.hint: won't 是 will not 的縮寫，後接原形動詞；be 的原形就是 be。

quiz.question: Mom ___ going to buy some flowers tomorrow.
quiz.hint: be going to 句型中的 be 要配合主詞。Mom 是第三人稱單數，所以用 is。

quiz.question: My cousins ___ going to stay at a hotel next week.
quiz.hint: My cousins 是複數，be going to 的 be 要用 are。

quiz.question: We are going to ___ some local food on our trip.
quiz.hint: are going to 表未來計畫，to 後接原形動詞 try。

quiz.question: I am not ___ to sell my old bike next month.
quiz.hint: 完整的否定句型是 am not going to + 原形動詞，所以空格填 going。

quiz.question: A: Will you take a trip during the vacation? B: Yes, I ___.
quiz.hint: 問句用 Will，肯定簡答也用 will：Yes, I will.，不改用 do 或 be。

quiz.question: A: Will the vendor open his stall tomorrow? B: No, he ___.
quiz.hint: Will 開頭的問句，否定簡答是 No, he won't.；won't 等於 will not。

quiz.question: A: Are your parents going to visit the church? B: Yes, they ___.
quiz.hint: 問句用 Are ... going to，簡答保留 be 動詞；they 是複數，所以回答 Yes, they are.。

quiz.question: A: Is Rita going to pay in cash? B: No, she ___.
quiz.hint: Is ... going to 的否定簡答用 isn't；she 對應 is，時態維持現在。

quiz.question: A: ___ will you stay during the trip? B: At a hotel near the bank.
quiz.hint: 回答 At a hotel near the bank. 是地點，因此用 Where 問住在哪裡。

quiz.question: A: ___ will the tour begin? B: At nine tomorrow morning.
quiz.hint: At nine tomorrow morning. 回答時間，所以用 When；不是問地點、人物或方式。

quiz.question: A: ___ will we stay in Bangkok? B: For three nights.
quiz.hint: For three nights. 表示停留的時間長度，因此用 How long；How often 問頻率。

quiz.question: A: ___ are you going to get to the bank? B: By bus.
quiz.hint: By bus. 說明交通方式，因此疑問詞用 How，詢問要如何到銀行。

quiz.question: A: ___ is going to sell the boat? B: My uncle is.
quiz.hint: My uncle is. 指出做這件事的人，因此用 Who 當疑問主詞。

quiz.question: Dad will visit the flower shop later, and Mom ___, too.
quiz.hint: 後半句省略重複的 visit the flower shop later，保留與前句相同的助動詞 will。

quiz.question: Lily is going to buy a fan, and I ___, too.
quiz.hint: 後半句省略 going to buy a fan，保留 be 動詞；主詞 I 要搭配 am。

quiz.question: The vendor will ___ careful when he packs the eggs.
quiz.hint: careful 是形容詞，前面需要 be 動詞；will 後面用原形 be。

quiz.question: There will ___ a new bookstore near the bridge.
quiz.hint: 表示「將會有」用 There will be，存在句不能把 be 換成 have；will 後也不能用 is。

quiz.question: There ___ going to be a new hotel in town.
quiz.hint: There is going to be 後接單數名詞 a new hotel，所以第一個 be 用 is。

quiz.question: There ___ going to be two flower shops here next year.
quiz.hint: 後面的 two flower shops 是複數，因此用 There are going to be。

quiz.question: The tickets are booked. My parents are ___ for Taipei tomorrow.
quiz.hint: 機票已訂好，表示已安排的未來行程；句中已有 are，後面用 leaving 構成現在進行式。

quiz.question: I'll buy some bread before the bakery ___ at six tonight.
quiz.hint: 主句 I'll buy 表未來；before 引導的未來時間子句用現在式。the bakery 是單數，所以用 closes。

quiz.question: After Jay ___ home tomorrow, he will count his cash.
quiz.hint: after 引導未來時間子句，動詞用現在式，不用 will；Jay 是單數，填 gets。

quiz.question: When we ___ at the metro station tonight, we will call you.
quiz.hint: when 引導的未來時間子句用現在式；主詞 we 搭配 arrive，不在子句中加 will。

quiz.question: The bank will open after the manager ___ tomorrow morning.
quiz.hint: after 子句用現在式表未來；the manager 是第三人稱單數，因此用 arrives。

quiz.question: The toy boat ___ me eighty dollars yesterday.
quiz.hint: 主詞 The toy boat 是物品，後面是金額，用 cost；yesterday 表過去，而 cost 的過去式仍是 cost。

quiz.question: The vendor ___ three hundred dollars for a new fan yesterday.
quiz.hint: 人 + pay + 金額 + for + 物；yesterday 表過去，pay 要改成 paid。

quiz.question: I spent two hundred dollars ___ flowers for my mother.
quiz.hint: 人 + spent + 金錢後接動作時，要用 V-ing，因此是 buying，不能用 to buy。

quiz.question: It cost us a thousand dollars ___ a night at the hotel.
quiz.hint: 句型是 It cost + 人 + 金額 + to V；空格要用不定詞 to spend。

quiz.question: This small fan usually ___ two hundred dollars.
quiz.hint: This small fan 是單數主詞，usually 表示一般情況；現在式 cost 要加 s，成為 costs。

quiz.question: At our hotel, each guest ___ one hundred dollars on lunch every day.
quiz.hint: each guest 表示每一位客人，視為單數；every day 表現在習慣，所以用 spends。

quiz.question: How much did you ___ for these shoes last night?
quiz.hint: 問句中的 did 已表示過去，後面的主要動詞要恢復原形 pay，不再用 paid。

quiz.question: A: ___ did the meal cost you? B: Six hundred dollars.
quiz.hint: 回答是金額 six hundred dollars，因此用 How much 問花多少錢。

quiz.question: A: One book costs ninety dollars. How much will two books ___? B: One hundred and eighty dollars.
quiz.hint: 空格前已有助動詞 will，所以用原形 cost；不能加 s，也不能寫成 costed。

quiz.question: We will ___ three hundred dollars on local food tomorrow.
quiz.hint: 人 + spend + 金額 + on + 事物；will 後接原形動詞 spend。

quiz.question: These toy boats ___ forty dollars each.
quiz.hint: These toy boats 是複數主詞，表示售價用現在式 cost；不能用單數形式 costs。

quiz.question: After buying the gift, she had no money left. She ___ all her cash on it.
quiz.hint: 主詞 She 是人，後面是金錢及 on it，符合人 + spent + 金錢 + on + 物的句型。

quiz.question: It took us twenty minutes ___ the bridge.
quiz.hint: 句型是 It took + 人 + 時間 + to V，因此填 to cross；不使用 spend 句型的 V-ing。

quiz.question: We spent an hour ___ the local market.
quiz.hint: spend + 時間後接動作時用 V-ing，因此是 visiting。

quiz.question: A: ___ does it take to reach the hotel? B: About fifteen minutes.
quiz.hint: fifteen minutes 是時間長度，所以用 How long；不是問金額、數量或年齡。

quiz.question: Cleaning the stall ___ him thirty minutes every evening.
quiz.hint: 動名詞片語 Cleaning the stall 作主詞，整件事視為單數；現在式用 takes。

quiz.question: It will take ___ two hours to reach the church.
quiz.hint: 在 take 後表示花費時間的人，要用受格代名詞 us；we 是主格，our／ours 表所有關係。

quiz.question: How long did you ___ waiting at the bank?
quiz.hint: did 後面的主要動詞用原形 spend；waiting 則是 spend 句型所接的 V-ing。

quiz.question: It will ___ ten minutes to walk to the bakery.
quiz.hint: It will take + 時間 + to V 表未來花多少時間；will 後面的 take 用原形。

quiz.question: Mia ___ twenty minutes reading the tour plan last night.
quiz.hint: Mia 是人，後面是時間及 reading，符合 spent + 時間 + V-ing；last night 要用過去式。

quiz.question: It ___ me thirty minutes to reach the flower shop yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表過去；It take + 人 + 時間 + to V 中的 take 應改成過去式 took。

quiz.question: Dad spends ten minutes ___ prices before he buys anything.
quiz.hint: spends + 時間後面的動作要用 V-ing，因此填 checking。

quiz.question: Does it ___ long to get to the metro station?
quiz.hint: 問句已有 Does，主要動詞須用原形 take，不再加 s；此處詢問花費時間。

quiz.question: A: I spent half an hour fixing the fan. B: So it took you half an hour ___ it?
quiz.hint: 同義轉換時，spent + 時間 + fixing 要改成 It took + 人 + 時間 + to fix。

vocab.sentence: We will visit the temple tomorrow.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們明天會參觀那座寺廟。

vocab.sentence: Mom will buy some milk at the supermarket.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 媽媽會去超級市場買一些牛奶。

vocab.sentence: We are going to eat at this restaurant.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們打算在這間餐廳用餐。

vocab.sentence: Dad will go to the bank after lunch.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 爸爸午餐後會去銀行。

vocab.sentence: It takes ten minutes to walk to the church.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 走路到教堂需要 10 分鐘。

vocab.sentence: The bakery will open at seven tomorrow morning.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那間麵包店明天早上 7 點會開門。

vocab.sentence: We will cross the bridge on foot.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們會走路過橋。

vocab.sentence: We will stay at this hotel for two nights.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們會在這間飯店住 2 晚。

vocab.sentence: She spent two hours shopping at the department store.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 她花了 2 小時在百貨公司購物。

vocab.sentence: There will be a metro station near our school.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們學校附近將會有一座捷運站。

vocab.sentence: I am going to visit the bookstore after school.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我打算放學後去書店。

vocab.sentence: He will send the letter at the post office.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他會去郵局寄那封信。

vocab.sentence: I will buy some roses at the flower shop.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我會去花店買一些玫瑰。

vocab.sentence: Our trip will begin next Monday.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們的旅行將在下週一開始。

vocab.sentence: We will visit our grandparents during the vacation.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們會在假期期間探望祖父母。

vocab.sentence: Where will you go on vacation this summer?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你今年暑假會去哪裡度假？

vocab.sentence: I will call you when I get home.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我到家時會打電話給你。

vocab.sentence: She will have her own room next year.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 她明年會有自己的房間。

vocab.sentence: We are going to try some local food.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們打算品嚐一些當地食物。

vocab.sentence: The tour will take about three hours.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這趟旅遊行程將花費大約 3 小時。

vocab.sentence: We spent an hour walking around the market.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們花了 1 小時逛市場。

vocab.sentence: The boat cost him three thousand dollars.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那艘小船花了他 3 千元。

vocab.sentence: Each student will pay fifty dollars for the trip.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 每位學生都將為這趟旅行支付 50 元。

vocab.sentence: I paid two hundred dollars for this bag.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我花了 200 元買這個袋子。

vocab.sentence: Are you going to leave for Taipei tomorrow?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你明天打算前往臺北嗎？

vocab.sentence: It took us almost an hour to get there.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們花了將近 1 小時到那裡。

vocab.sentence: We will decide where to eat after the tour.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們會在行程結束後決定去哪裡吃飯。

vocab.sentence: This meal cost us five hundred dollars.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這頓飯花了我們 500 元。

vocab.sentence: This fan will keep the room cool.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這台電扇會讓房間保持涼爽。

vocab.sentence: They will leave for Bangkok next week.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他們下週將前往曼谷。

vocab.sentence: The vendor will sell fruit at the market tomorrow.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那位攤販明天會在市場賣水果。

vocab.sentence: We will have a quick meal before the trip.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們會在旅行前快速吃一餐。

vocab.sentence: The vendor is going to open a new stall.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那位攤販打算開一個新攤位。

vocab.sentence: I will be careful when I cross the road.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我過馬路時會小心。

vocab.sentence: It will take an hour to get there by boat.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 搭船到那裡將需要 1 小時。

vocab.sentence: They are going to sell their old boat.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他們打算賣掉舊船。

vocab.sentence: We will sit on the low wall near the bridge.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們會坐在橋邊的矮牆上。

vocab.sentence: The price of this fan will go up next month.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這台電扇的價格下個月會上漲。

vocab.sentence: I will remember to bring enough money.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我會記得帶足夠的錢。

vocab.sentence: Will you pay in cash at the hotel?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你會在飯店用現金付款嗎？

vocab.sentence: We are going to have a wonderful vacation.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們將會度過一個美好的假期。

phrases.sentence: I plan to take a trip to the mountains.
Eddie decided to start a business on his own.
Sammy did a good job on the presentation.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Sammy 在報告中做得很好。

phrases.sentence: Same here! It's my favorite food, too!
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我也是！它也是我最喜愛的食物！

phrases.sentence: We must leave for the airport early to catch the morning flight.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們必須早點前往機場，以便趕上早班機。

phrases.sentence: The vacation package costs an arm and a leg.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 這個度假套裝行程極其昂貴。

phrases.sentence: Take your time and finish the project carefully.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 慢慢來，並仔細地完成這個專案計畫。

phrases.sentence: Dave paid for the car repairs in cash.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Dave 用現金支付了修理汽車的費用。

grammar.sentence: There will be a bookstore near the bank.

grammar.sentence: She spent an hour choosing a birthday gift.

grammar.sentence: I will call you when I get home.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我到家時會打電話給你。

grammar.sentence: How much did you pay for the fan?

grammar.sentence: How long does it take to reach the bridge?

grammar.sentence: She will buy bread before the bakery closes.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 她會在麵包店打烊前買麵包。

grammar.sentence: The vendor spent an hour cleaning his stall.

grammar.sentence: These bags cost fifty dollars each.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這些袋子每個要 50 元。

grammar.sentence: I am going to pay in cash.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我打算用現金付款。

grammar.sentence: Walking to the post office takes ten minutes.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 走路到郵局需要 10 分鐘。

grammar.sentence: When will the tour begin tomorrow morning?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這趟旅遊行程明天早上幾點開始？

grammar.sentence: We spent five hundred dollars buying local food.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們花了 500 元買當地食物。

grammar.sentence: They will leave after the rain stops.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 雨停後他們就會離開。

grammar.sentence: It took us twenty minutes to get home.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們花了 20 分鐘到家。

grammar.sentence: My parents are going to visit the church.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我的父母打算參觀那座教堂。

grammar.sentence: How much does this small fan cost?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這台小電扇多少錢？

grammar.sentence: She will be careful on the boat.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 她在船上會小心。

grammar.sentence: He spends an hour reading every night.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 他每晚花 1 小時閱讀。

grammar.sentence: Where are you going to stay tonight?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你今晚打算住在哪裡？

grammar.sentence: It cost him a thousand dollars to fix the bike.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 他花了 1 千元修理腳踏車。

grammar.sentence: The children will not cross the bridge alone.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 孩子們不會獨自過橋。

cloze_quiz.question: Visitors pray to the gods at this old ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: pray to the gods 是向神明祈禱；temple 指寺廟。

cloze_quiz.question: We need milk, eggs, and rice. Let's buy them at the ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: milk、eggs、rice 是食物與日用品；supermarket 是可一次購買這些東西的超級市場。

cloze_quiz.question: The waiter showed us to a table in the ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: waiter 和 table 是用餐線索；restaurant 是餐廳。

cloze_quiz.question: I need to take some money out of my account at the ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: money、account 表示從帳戶領錢；bank 是銀行。

cloze_quiz.question: The family goes to the ___ to listen to the pastor every Sunday.
cloze_quiz.hint: pastor 是牧師；到 church（教堂）聽牧師講道。

cloze_quiz.question: The smell of fresh bread comes from the ___ across the street.
cloze_quiz.hint: fresh bread 是剛出爐的麵包；bakery 是麵包店。

cloze_quiz.question: The river is too deep to walk through, so we will cross the ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: cross 和 river 是線索；bridge 是讓人跨越河流的橋。

cloze_quiz.question: We booked a room for two nights at a ___ near the airport.
cloze_quiz.hint: booked a room、two nights 表示訂房住宿；hotel 是飯店。

cloze_quiz.question: The first floor of this ___ sells bags, and the fifth floor sells beds.
cloze_quiz.hint: 不同樓層販售包包、床等不同商品，是 department store（百貨公司）的情境。

cloze_quiz.question: We are waiting for the next metro train inside the ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: metro train 是捷運列車；等車的地點是 metro station（捷運站）。

cloze_quiz.question: This ___ sells only new and used books.
cloze_quiz.hint: new and used books 指新書與二手書；bookstore 是書店。

cloze_quiz.question: Please buy some stamps and mail this letter at the ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: stamps 和 mail this letter 是郵寄線索；post office 是郵局。

cloze_quiz.question: They sell fresh roses and lilies at the ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: roses 和 lilies 都是花；flower shop 是花店。

cloze_quiz.question: Our school ___ to the zoo starts at eight tomorrow morning.
cloze_quiz.hint: to the zoo、starts at eight 描述去動物園的行程；trip 是旅行。

cloze_quiz.question: Please turn off your phone ___ the movie.
cloze_quiz.hint: 句意是電影播放期間關掉手機；during 表示在某段時間期間。

cloze_quiz.question: School is closed for two weeks, so we can take a family ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 學校放假 2 週，可以安排全家度假；vacation 是假期。

cloze_quiz.question: A: Will Dad come to the concert tomorrow? B: Yes, he ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: Will 開頭的問句用 will 簡答；will 表示將、會。

cloze_quiz.question: This is my ___ room. I don't have to share it with anyone.
cloze_quiz.hint: 不必與別人共用，表示是自己的房間；own 是自己的。

cloze_quiz.question: Ask a ___ person for directions; people who live here know the streets well.
cloze_quiz.hint: people who live here 指住在這裡的人；local 是當地的。

cloze_quiz.question: The guide will lead our ___ of the city this afternoon.
cloze_quiz.hint: guide 帶領大家遊覽城市；tour 是旅遊行程。

cloze_quiz.question: We want to ___ less money buying snacks this month.
cloze_quiz.hint: 人 + spend + 金錢 + V-ing 表示花錢做某事；spend 是花費。

cloze_quiz.question: Nine hundred plus one hundred is one ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 900 加 100 等於 1,000；thousand 表示千。

cloze_quiz.question: There are four children and four gifts. Give one gift to ___ child.
cloze_quiz.hint: 4 位孩子各得到 1 份禮物；each 表示每一個，後接單數 child。

cloze_quiz.question: You must ___ for the tickets before you enter the theater.
cloze_quiz.hint: pay for 表示付錢購買；進場前要先付票錢。

cloze_quiz.question: Today is Monday. We will have our Tuesday meeting ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 今天星期一，星期二就是明天；tomorrow 是明天。

cloze_quiz.question: Ninety-nine of the hundred seats are full, so the bus is ___ full.
cloze_quiz.hint: 100 個座位已有 99 個坐滿，表示幾乎全滿；almost 是幾乎，不是完全或一半。

cloze_quiz.question: We must ___ which hotel to book before we buy the tickets.
cloze_quiz.hint: which hotel to book 表示要選訂哪家飯店；decide 是決定。

cloze_quiz.question: How much does that camera ___?
cloze_quiz.hint: 詢問相機的價格，物作主詞用 cost，表示花費金錢。

cloze_quiz.question: It's hot in here. Please turn on the ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 天氣熱、turn on 是打開電器；fan 在這裡是電扇。

cloze_quiz.question: They will ___ Kaohsiung tomorrow and arrive there before lunch.
cloze_quiz.hint: arrive there before lunch 表示要前往高雄；leave for 是前往。

cloze_quiz.question: Selling fruit from a market stall is his job. He is a ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 工作是在市場擺攤賣水果，職業是 vendor（攤販）；其他選項指訪客、顧客或遊客。

cloze_quiz.question: We have only five minutes for lunch, so we need a ___ meal.
cloze_quiz.hint: 只有 5 分鐘吃午餐，表示需要迅速用餐；quick 是迅速的。

cloze_quiz.question: We bought noodles from a small ___ at the night market.
cloze_quiz.hint: 夜市裡賣麵的小店位是 stall（攤位）。

cloze_quiz.question: The glass is easy to break. Please be ___ with it.
cloze_quiz.hint: 玻璃容易破，要小心拿；careful 是小心的。

cloze_quiz.question: We crossed the lake in a small ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: crossed the lake 表示穿越湖面；boat 是小船。

cloze_quiz.question: They plan to ___ their old car for fifty thousand dollars.
cloze_quiz.hint: 以 5 萬元賣出舊車，動詞用 sell，表示賣、出售。

cloze_quiz.question: The shelf is so ___ that even a small child can reach it.
cloze_quiz.hint: 連小孩都碰得到，表示架子很低；low 是低的。

cloze_quiz.question: The ___ on this bag's tag is NT$300.
cloze_quiz.hint: tag 上的 NT$300 是商品標價；price 是價格。

cloze_quiz.question: Please ___ to bring your passport to the airport.
cloze_quiz.hint: 句意是提醒對方帶護照；remember to do something 表示記得去做某事。

cloze_quiz.question: The shop doesn't take cards, so please bring enough ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 店家不收卡片付款，因此要帶現金；cash 是現金。

cloze_quiz.question: We had a ___ day at the beach; everyone enjoyed it.
cloze_quiz.hint: everyone enjoyed it 表示大家都很開心；wonderful 是美好的。
